subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public before_tool_call policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose, and which provenance/session/action facts are safe for ordinary plugins versus trusted policy plugins?
rationale: This defines a public Plugin SDK security-policy surface, and automation cannot choose the taxonomy, redaction boundary, or trust-tier visibility without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define Unified Policy Facts
options.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it across core tool calls, plugin tools, trusted policy events, docs, and API baselines.

options.title: Land Narrow Provenance Slices First
options.body: Accept narrower work such as external-content provenance while keeping this issue open for the broader action and input provenance design.

options.title: Defer Hook Enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape until capability descriptors, Security Matrix, and provenance visibility are settled together.

recommendation.title: Define Unified Policy Facts
recommendation.body: Approve one additive contract covering action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it across core tool calls, plugin tools, trusted policy events, docs, and API baselines.

likelyOwner.reason: The generic host-hook contract work is the closest merged SDK seam for deciding public trusted-policy and before_tool_call facts.
